metadata.name: West Antarctic Snow and Ice Depth Measurements from DML21/22 Campaign
metadata.description: A dataset containing 578 high-frequency measurements of snow and ice depth (total, top, and bottom) and snow density collected at a localized transect in West Antarctica (approx. 73°S, 13°W) between December 10, 2021, and January 8, 2022. The data includes geospatial coordinates, timestamps, and physical properties of the snowpack, ranging from fresh powder to dense firn.
metadata.spatial: Point locations along a transect spanning approximately 63 km north-south and 30-40 km east-west
metadata.temporal: High-frequency sampling with approximately 20 measurements per day over a 29-day period
